verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Clerk publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json and markdown docs. Neither is an interactive API reference with runnable, try-it examples. A raw spec is only a building block for such an explorer, and nothing in the pack documents an in-browser API explorer or runnable request examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
